{{Top|leg}}
The '''Parallax Chain''' was a secret society of independent [[Captain/Legends|captains]] that dealt in some of the most reviled criminal activities in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Although most were not outright [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], they were often willing to deal in lives for profit, and valued new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to exploit for slaves.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
